Laporan Praktikum 10 - Pengembangan Web Service
Implementasi Express.js AI Chatbot Menggunakan Model Liquid LFM 2.5 (OpenRouter API)
Nama Mahasiswa Ilham Saputra
NIM 20240140118
Praktikum / Matkul Pengembangan Web Service (Praktikum 10)
Link Repositori GitHub https://github.com/ilham101106/118_ChatboxAI.git
1. Deskripsi Pengerjaan Tugas

Pada praktikum 10 ini, saya membuat aplikasi web chatbox interaktif berbasis Node.js & Express.js. Server Express bertindak sebagai backend penyedia API yang menghubungkan aplikasi web ke model AI Liquid LFM 2.5 2.6B Free (liquid/lfm-2.5-2.6b:free) melalui OpenRouter API. Antarmuka dibuat responsif dengan fitur collapsible drawer settings, Markdown formatting, serta rendering blok kode interaktif.

2. Hasil Tangkapan Layar (Screenshots UI & Chat AI)
A. Tampilan Percakapan Aktif dengan AI (Liquid LFM 2.5) Status: Response OK
B. Panel Pengaturan API Key & Model (Collapsible Settings Drawer) Status: API Key Connected

📄 server.js
Node.js / Express
  1  const express = require('express');
  2  const cors = require('cors');
  3  const axios = require('axios');
  4  const path = require('path');
  5  require('dotenv').config();
  6  
  7  const app = express();
  8  const PORT = process.env.PORT || 3000;
  9  
 10  // Middleware
 11  app.use(cors());
 12  app.use(express.json({ limit: '10mb' }));
 13  app.use(express.static(path.join(__dirname, 'public')));
 14  
 15  // OpenRouter Base Endpoint
 16  const OPENROUTER_API_URL = 'https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/chat/completions';
 17  const DEFAULT_MODEL = process.env.DEFAULT_MODEL || 'liquid/lfm-2.5-2.6b:free';
 18  
 19  // Health Check Endpoint
 20  app.get('/api/health', (req, res) => {
 21    res.json({
 22      status: 'ok',
 23      timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
 24      defaultModel: DEFAULT_MODEL,
 25      hasServerApiKey: Boolean(process.env.OPENROUTER_API_KEY)
 26    });
 27  });
 28  
 29  // Chat API Endpoint
 30  app.post('/api/chat', async (req, res) => {
 31    try {
 32      const { messages, apiKey: clientApiKey, model, systemPrompt } = req.body;
 33  
 34      // Prioritaskan API Key dari Client UI (Opsi 2), jika tidak ada baru gunakan process.env
 35      const apiKey = clientApiKey || process.env.OPENROUTER_API_KEY;
 36  
 37      if (!apiKey || apiKey.trim() === '') {
 38        return res.status(400).json({
 39          error: {
 40            message: 'OpenRouter API Key belum diatur. Silakan masukkan API Key Anda di menu Pengaturan (UI) atau di file .env.'
 41          }
 42        });
 43      }
 44  
 45      if (!messages || !Array.isArray(messages) || messages.length === 0) {
 46        return res.status(400).json({
 47          error: {
 48            message: 'Format pesan tidak valid atau kosong.'
 49          }
 50        });
 51      }
 52  
 53      // Susun payload pesan dengan System Prompt jika ada
 54      const formattedMessages = [];
 55      if (systemPrompt && systemPrompt.trim() !== '') {
 56        formattedMessages.push({
 57          role: 'system',
 58          content: systemPrompt.trim()
 59        });
 60      }
 61      
 62      // Tambahkan percakapan user & assistant
 63      messages.forEach((msg) => {
 64        formattedMessages.push({
 65          role: msg.role === 'user' ? 'user' : 'assistant',
 66          content: msg.content
 67        });
 68      });
 69  
 70      const activeModel = model || DEFAULT_MODEL;
 71  
 72      // Kirim request ke OpenRouter API
 73      const response = await axios.post(
 74        OPENROUTER_API_URL,
 75        {
 76          model: activeModel,
 77          messages: formattedMessages,
 78          temperature: 0.7,
 79          max_tokens: 2048
 80        },
 81        {
 82          headers: {
 83            'Authorization': `Bearer ${apiKey.trim()}`,
 84            'HTTP-Referer': `http://localhost:${PORT}`,
 85            'X-Title': 'Express AI Chatbox App',
 86            'Content-Type': 'application/json'
 87          },
 88          timeout: 60000 // 60 seconds timeout
 89        }
 90      );
 91  
 92      // Ambil jawaban AI dari response OpenRouter
 93      const choice = response.data?.choices?.[0];
 94      const aiMessage = choice?.message?.content || 'Tidak ada balasan dari model AI.';
 95  
 96      return res.json({
 97        success: true,
 98        message: aiMessage,
 99        model: activeModel,
100        usage: response.data?.usage || null
101      });
102  
103    } catch (error) {
104      console.error('Error saat menghubungi OpenRouter API:', error.response?.data || error.message);
105  
106      const statusCode = error.response?.status || 500;
107      let errorMessage = error.response?.data?.error?.message || 
108                           error.response?.data?.message || 
109                           error.message || 
110                           'Terjadi kesalahan internal pada server.';
111  
112      // Penanganan khusus jika API key salah / tidak terdaftar di OpenRouter
113      if (errorMessage.includes('User not found') || statusCode === 401) {
114        errorMessage = 'API Key OpenRouter tidak valid atau tidak ditemukan. Pastikan Anda menyalin key dari https://openrouter.ai/keys (format diawali dengan `sk-or-v1-...`).';
115      }
116  
117      return res.status(statusCode).json({
118        error: {
119          message: errorMessage,
120          status: statusCode
121        }
122      });
123    }
124  });
125  
126  // Fallback route untuk SPA/HTML
127  app.get('*', (req, res) => {
128    res.sendFile(path.join(__dirname, 'public', 'index.html'));
129  });
130  
131  // Start Server
132  app.listen(PORT, () => {
133    console.log(`===================================================`);
134    console.log(`🚀 Express AI Chatbox Server berjalan di port ${PORT}`);
135    console.log(`🔗 Buka di browser: http://localhost:${PORT}`);
136    console.log(`🤖 Model Default: ${DEFAULT_MODEL}`);
137    console.log(`===================================================`);
138  });

139    // --- Append Single Message to UI ---
140    function appendMessageUI(role, content, timestamp = new Date().toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' }), animate = true) {
141      welcomeHero.style.display = 'none';
142      messagesContainer.style.display = 'flex';
143  
144      const messageItem = document.createElement('div');
145      messageItem.className = `message-item ${role}`;
146      if (!animate) messageItem.style.animation = 'none';
147  
148      const avatarHtml = role === 'user' 
149        ? `<div class="avatar user-avatar"><i class="fa-solid fa-user"></i></div>`
150        : `<div class="avatar ai-avatar"><i class="fa-solid fa-droplet"></i></div>`;
151  
152      // Process Markdown for AI messages
153      const formattedContent = role === 'assistant' ? processMarkdown(content) : escapeHtml(content);
154  
155      messageItem.innerHTML = `
156        ${avatarHtml}
157        <div class="message-bubble-wrapper">
158          <div class="message-bubble">${formattedContent}</div>
159          <div class="message-meta">
160            <span>${role === 'user' ? 'Anda' : 'Liquid AI'}</span> • <span>${timestamp}</span>
161          </div>
162        </div>
163      `;
164  
165      messagesContainer.appendChild(messageItem);
166      attachCopyCodeListeners(messageItem);
167      scrollToBottom();
168    }
169  
170    // --- Process Markdown & Format Code Blocks with Copy Buttons ---
171    function processMarkdown(rawText) {
172      let html = marked.parse(rawText);
173  
174      const tempDiv = document.createElement('div');
175      tempDiv.innerHTML = html;
176  
177      const preElements = tempDiv.querySelectorAll('pre');
178      preElements.forEach((pre) => {
179        const codeElem = pre.querySelector('code');
180        let lang = 'code';
181  
182        if (codeElem) {
183          const classNames = codeElem.className.split(' ');
184          classNames.forEach(cls => {
185            if (cls.startsWith('language-')) {
186              lang = cls.replace('language-', '');
187            }
188          });
189        }
190  
191        const codeHeader = document.createElement('div');
192        codeHeader.className = 'code-header';
193        codeHeader.innerHTML = `
194          <span><i class="fa-solid fa-code"></i> ${lang}</span>
195          <button class="copy-btn"><i class="fa-regular fa-copy"></i> Salin</button>
196        `;
197  
198        pre.insertBefore(codeHeader, pre.firstChild);
199      });
200  
201      return tempDiv.innerHTML;
202    }
203  
204    // --- Attach Copy Listener to Code Snippets ---
205    function attachCopyCodeListeners(container) {
206      const copyBtns = container.querySelectorAll('.copy-btn');
207      copyBtns.forEach(btn => {
208        btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
209          const pre = btn.closest('pre');
210          const code = pre.querySelector('code')?.innerText || '';
211  
212          navigator.clipboard.writeText(code).then(() => {
213            btn.innerHTML = `<i class="fa-solid fa-check"></i> Tersalin!`;
214            setTimeout(() => {
215              btn.innerHTML = `<i class="fa-regular fa-copy"></i> Salin`;
216            }, 2000);
217          }).catch(err => {
218            console.error('Gagal menyalin:', err);
219          });
220        });
221      });
222    }
223  
224    // --- Escape Raw HTML for User Safety ---
225    function escapeHtml(text) {
226      const div = document.createElement('div');
227      div.textContent = text;
228      return div.innerHTML.replace(/\n/g, '<br>');
229    }
230  
231    // --- Scroll Chat to Bottom ---
232    function scrollToBottom() {
233      chatBody.scrollTo({
234        top: chatBody.scrollHeight,
235        behavior: 'smooth'
236      });
237    }
238  
239    // --- Send Message Handler ---
240    async function handleSendMessage() {
241      const promptText = userPromptInput.value.trim();
242      if (!promptText) return;
243  
244      // Check API Key
245      if (!apiKey || apiKey.trim() === '') {
246        openSidebar();
247        apiKeyInput.focus();
248        alert('Silakan masukkan OpenRouter API Key Anda terlebih dahulu di menu Pengaturan!');
249        return;
250      }
251  
252      // Collapse sidebar saat mulai mengirim pesan agar layar lebih luas
253      closeSidebar();
254  
255      // Append User Message to State & UI
256      const timeNow = new Date().toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' });
257      const userMessage = { role: 'user', content: promptText, timestamp: timeNow };
258      chatHistory.push(userMessage);
259      localStorage.setItem('chat_history', JSON.stringify(chatHistory));
260  
261      appendMessageUI('user', promptText, timeNow);
262  
263      // Reset Input
264      userPromptInput.value = '';
265      autoResizeTextarea();
266  
267      // Show Typing Indicator
268      typingIndicator.classList.add('active');
269      sendBtn.disabled = true;
270      scrollToBottom();
271  
272      try {
273        const apiMessagesPayload = chatHistory.map(item => ({
274          role: item.role,
275          content: item.content
276        }));
277  
278        const response = await fetch('/api/chat', {
279          method: 'POST',
280          headers: {
281            'Content-Type': 'application/json'
282          },
283          body: JSON.stringify({
284            messages: apiMessagesPayload,
285            apiKey: apiKey.trim(),
286            model: selectedModel,
287            systemPrompt: systemPrompt
288          })
289        });
290  
291        const data = await response.json();
292  
293        if (!response.ok) {
294          throw new Error(data.error?.message || 'Terjadi kesalahan saat menghubungkan ke AI.');
295        }
296  
297        const aiReply = data.message || 'Tidak ada balasan dari AI.';
298        const aiTime = new Date().toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' });
299  
300        // Save Assistant Message
301        const aiMessageObj = { role: 'assistant', content: aiReply, timestamp: aiTime };
302        chatHistory.push(aiMessageObj);
303        localStorage.setItem('chat_history', JSON.stringify(chatHistory));
304  
305        appendMessageUI('assistant', aiReply, aiTime);
306  
307      } catch (error) {
308        console.error('Chat Error:', error);
309        const errTime = new Date().toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' });
310        const errorMessage = `⚠️ **Error:** ${error.message}`;
311        
312        appendMessageUI('assistant', errorMessage, errTime);
313      } finally {
314        typingIndicator.classList.remove('active');
315        sendBtn.disabled = false;
316        scrollToBottom();
317      }
318    }
319  
320    // --- Event Listeners Setup ---
321    function setupEventListeners() {
322      // Sidebar Toggles
323      if (toggleSidebarBtn) toggleSidebarBtn.addEventListener('click', toggleSidebar);
324      if (closeSidebarBtn) closeSidebarBtn.addEventListener('click', closeSidebar);
325      if (sidebarOverlay) sidebarOverlay.addEventListener('click', closeSidebar);
326  
327      if (openSettingsFromBanner) {
328        openSettingsFromBanner.addEventListener('click', () => {
329          openSidebar();
330          apiKeyInput.focus();
331        });
332      }
333  
334      // Save API Key
335      saveApiKeyBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
336        apiKey = apiKeyInput.value.trim();
337        localStorage.setItem('openrouter_api_key', apiKey);
338        updateApiKeyUI();
339  
340        saveApiKeyBtn.innerHTML = `<i class="fa-solid fa-check"></i> Tersimpan!`;
341        setTimeout(() => {
342          saveApiKeyBtn.innerHTML = `<i class="fa-solid fa-floppy-disk"></i> Simpan Key`;
343          closeSidebar();
344        }, 1200);
345      });
346  
347      // Toggle Eye Password
348      toggleApiKeyVisibility.addEventListener('click', () => {
349        const type = apiKeyInput.getAttribute('type') === 'password' ? 'text' : 'password';
350        apiKeyInput.setAttribute('type', type);
351        toggleApiKeyVisibility.innerHTML = type === 'password' 
352          ? `<i class="fa-solid fa-eye"></i>` 
353          : `<i class="fa-solid fa-eye-slash"></i>`;
354      });
355  
356      // Change Model
357      modelSelect.addEventListener('change', (e) => {
358        selectedModel = e.target.value;
359        localStorage.setItem('selected_model', selectedModel);
360        activeModelLabel.textContent = selectedModel;
361      });
362  
363      // System Prompt Editor
364      systemPromptInput.addEventListener('input', (e) => {
365        systemPrompt = e.target.value;
366        localStorage.setItem('system_prompt', systemPrompt);
367      });
368  
369      resetSystemPromptBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
370        const defaultPrompt = 'Kamu adalah Liquid AI, asisten virtual yang cerdas, ramah, dan sangat membantu dalam bahasa Indonesia.';
371        systemPrompt = defaultPrompt;
372        systemPromptInput.value = defaultPrompt;
373        localStorage.setItem('system_prompt', defaultPrompt);
374      });
375  
376      // Clear Chat History
377      const clearChatHandler = () => {
378        if (confirm('Apakah Anda yakin ingin menghapus seluruh riwayat chat?')) {
379          chatHistory = [];
380          localStorage.removeItem('chat_history');
381          renderChatHistory();
382          closeSidebar();
383        }
384      };
385  
386      clearChatBtn.addEventListener('click', clearChatHandler);
387      quickClearBtn.addEventListener('click', clearChatHandler);
388  
389      // Auto resize input & keyboard shortcuts
390      userPromptInput.addEventListener('input', autoResizeTextarea);
391      userPromptInput.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
392        if (e.key === 'Enter' && !e.shiftKey) {
393          e.preventDefault();
394          handleSendMessage();
395        }
396      });
397  
398      // Form submit
399      chatForm.addEventListener('submit', (e) => {
400        e.preventDefault();
401        handleSendMessage();
402      });
403  
404      // Quick Suggestions
405      suggestionCards.forEach(card => {
406        card.addEventListener('click', () => {
407          const prompt = card.getAttribute('data-prompt');
408          if (prompt) {
409            userPromptInput.value = prompt;
410            autoResizeTextarea();
411            userPromptInput.focus();
412          }
413        });
414      });
415    }
416  
417    // Start App
418    init();
419  });
